name: ticketing-monorepo
//optionalDependencies: Linux native binaries for the Vercel build (Turbopack/lightningcss + Tailwind v4 oxide) and for vitest/rollup in CI, x64 and arm64 — the Docker image (Dockerfile) builds on whichever the host is, and an Apple Silicon host is arm64. npm skips them on macOS (os/cpu mismatch); declaring them forces full lockfile entries so a linux install actually gets them — otherwise it fails with 'Cannot find module …linux-x64-gnu(.node)'.
